title: pvFidesReader
body:
## pvFidesReader

Reads ADIOS2 output through the Fides library, which maps ADIOS2 variables to meshes using a data model; for a BP file or BP4/BP5 directory written with Fides metadata the data model is found automatically. The output is a partitioned dataset collection with the selected point, cell and field arrays and the stored time steps. Use it for Fides-annotated simulation output; use pvFidesJSONReader when the data model is a separate JSON file.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Array selections are made from names found in the file; list the arrays you need, because ParaView chooses the initial selection.
- Streaming (StreamSteps, SST engines) is for in-situ coupling; leave it unset for files on disk. ParaView's DataSourceIO is not exposed because it takes the memory address of a live ADIOS2 object, which Fides dereferences and which is meaningless outside a co-resident simulation.
- Schemaxis generates this reader binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check with a sample file of this format.

Native constructor: `FidesReader`. Identity: `sources/FidesFileReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellArrays` | This property lists which cell-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `ConvertToVTK` | This property determines whether data should be converted to VTK or stay in VTK-m format. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Createsharedpoints` | This property allows Fides to close gaps between blocks of structured grids by utilizing shared points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `DataSourceEngines` | Flat list of [source name, ADIOS2 engine] pairs choosing the engine used for each Fides data source, e.g. ["source", "BPFile"]. ADIOS2 engines include BP file engines and the SST staging engine; choosing SST switches the reader to streaming mode. Unlisted sources use the BP file engine. Complete tuples of 2 values. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FieldArrays` | This property lists which field arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FileName` | This property sets the ADIOS2 bp filename for Fides to read. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrays` | This property lists which point-centered arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `StreamSteps` | Reads the data as a stream, one step at a time as the writer releases it, instead of random access to all stored time steps. It is used for staging engines (SST) and BP5 streaming, and is switched on automatically when an SST engine is set. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "PrepareNextStep": {
    "command": "PrepareNextStep",
    "native": "PrepareNextStep"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {
    "DataSourceIO": "in-process memory address that the native reader dereferences; unsafe for authored input"
  },
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFidesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["PrepareNextStep"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
